blocks.x: And he wouldn’t put up with any discrimination

Oh no, if there was any kind of discrimination in any hall, quit. There was no conversation with the promoter at all, that was it, we were gone. And the money was no object, we would get paid. And there was no microphones all over because he went around in the hall, especially over in Europe, and looked at the wires, sometimes he’d just pull them out of the walls. He wasn’t going to let us get mistreated so far as making some tapes and selling them later on. Some of them might have gotten through but I doubt it because that teed him off when somebody would put a microphone in there, not even talking to him about remuneration, just guerilla cassette. The next thing you know, you hear it, it’s been sold. That was quite a thrill.
